gold_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT i.file_id
FROM code.imports i
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = i.file_id
WHERE i.imported_file_id = 'auto_ontology/dal/session.py' AND f.is_test
ORDER BY i.file_id;
